_comment: Real retailers and products, imported with `pnpm db:import-sources`.
Retailers listed here were reviewed on 2026-09-20 against their robots.txt:
see TCG Market Project/docs/scanner-source-review.md for the evidence.
eBay (web), Walmart (web), Star City Games and the Bandai Namco Store explicitly
disallow the search paths the scanner used, and Amazon and TCGplayer were dropped
on terms-of-service grounds, so none of them appear here.
